# Cube.AddAndExpandDimensionColumn

```m
Cube.AddAndExpandDimensionColumn(cube as table, dimensionSelector as any, attributeNames as list, optional newColumnNames as any) as table
```

Merges the specified dimension table into the cube’s filter context and changes the dimensional granularity of the filter context by expanding the specified set of dimension attributes.

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

Reference: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/cube-addandexpanddimensioncolumn)

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Optional |
|---|---|---|
| `cube` | `table` | no |
| `dimensionSelector` | `any` | no |
| `attributeNames` | `list` | no |
| `newColumnNames` | `any` | yes |
